Class PasskeyChallengeStore

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.security.passkey.PasskeyChallengeStore
@Component public class PasskeyChallengeStore extends Object
The issued WebAuthn challenges, held in the memory of this process because the application is stateless and keeps no HTTP session. An entry lives five minutes, at most 500 exist, and a full store refuses new entries instead of evicting a pending one. take(String) removes an entry and checks its age in one synchronized step, so a challenge can be answered once. Everything the answer is checked against comes from the entry, never from the client.
